rm.title: Rick & Morty Telegram Bot
rm.description: A .NET API in C# built around gameplay and item trading through Telegram commands: JWT authentication, item shop, player-to-player trading and SQL persistence.

ma.title: Mesero App
ma.description: An Android app in Java for end-to-end bar management: tables, products and orders in real time, stock control, automatic email invoicing and notifications. Persistence with Room and SharedPreferences, reactive UI with LiveData.

mw.title: Mesero Web
mw.description: The web version of the restaurant order management system, with a Java and Spring Boot backend. Actively in development.

mc.title: MiniCloud
mc.description: A multi-user system to upload, download and delete files securely, with automatic encryption and per-user storage. Serves multiple clients in parallel using Java threads. My most recent project.

tf.title: TaskFlow
tf.description: A project management app inspired by Jira: task creation and assignment, real-time status tracking. Spring Boot backend and React frontend.

rps.title: Rock Paper Scissors
rps.description: Rock paper scissors against your camera: combines Java game logic with computer vision, using OpenCV to detect the shape of the user's hand in real time.
